system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 12 hours, 20 Spell Uses. Lasts: Indefinitely. Removes any magical effects from an object or target. Kind of a dick move among wizards, but useful for spellbound maidens and cursed weapons. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
